In the center, a vendor in a green apron hands a pretzel to a girl with pigtails. The girl smiles while looking at the pretzel. Behind them, a horse pulling a sleigh stands still, its breath visible in the cold air. A driver in a fur hat holds the reins tightly. Near the edge, a police officer in a dark uniform watches the scene, standing next to a trash can. A pigeon perches on the trash can lid, looking down. In the background, a clock tower rises above the buildings, showing three o'clock. A flag waves from the tower's peak. A streetlight glows softly nearby. A pile of firewood rests against a wall.
